description: Glacial Vest Level 60 Craftsman Wilhelm at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 8 Frozen Runes, 8 Bolts of Runecloth, 6 Essences of Water, 4 Ironweb Spider Silks and 300 gold. You must also be of Exalted reputation with the Argent Dawn. Requirements: - Frozen Rune x 8 - Bolt of Runecloth x 8 - Essence of Water x 6 - Ironweb Spider Silk x 4 - Argent Dawn: - Money: 300
